title: Movable border between events and timezones
line: In the clock popup you can now drag the line between Events and Time Zones, and the size is remembered.
explanation: When the clock popup shows both events and time zones, the time zones list had a fixed size (between 7 and 10 grid units) and the events list took the rest. The line between them was only a drawing, so there was no way to give more room to either list. The separator line now has a drag area (with a vertical resize cursor) that sets the height of the time zones list, clamped so the events list keeps its minimum height, and the height is saved in the applet's config (new entry timeZonesHeight, 0 = the old automatic size).

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: make the border between events and time zones movable

The time zones list always took a fixed share of the popup, so with many
events or many time zones there was no way to give either one more room.
The separator line can now be dragged and the chosen height is remembered.

BUG: 433550

patches.diff:
From c993169b4ed65ad3f2321616945281a663a1f47f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 17:55:27 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: make the border between events and
 time zones movable

The time zones list always took a fixed share of the popup, so with many
events or many time zones there was no way to give either one more room.
The separator line can now be dragged and the chosen height is remembered.

BUG: 433550
---
 applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml | 30 ++++++++++++++++++++++++--
 applets/digital-clock/main.xml         |  4 ++++
 2 files changed, 32 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml b/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml
index 48d5dcccb7..b01b61cf09 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml
@@ -391,12 +391,35 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
         // Horizontal separator line between events and time zones
         KSvg.SvgItem {
             visible: worldClocks.visible && agenda.visible
+            z: 1
 
             Layout.fillWidth: true
             Layout.preferredHeight: naturalSize.height
 
             imagePath: "widgets/line"
             elementId: "horizontal-line"
+
+            // Drag to resize the time zones list against the events list
+            MouseArea {
+                property real pressY
+                property real pressHeight
+                property real maximumHeight
+
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                anchors.topMargin: -Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+                anchors.bottomMargin: -Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+                cursorShape: Qt.SizeVerCursor
+
+                onPressed: mouse => {
+                    pressY = mapToItem(leadingColumn, mouse.x, mouse.y).y;
+                    pressHeight = worldClocks.height;
+                    maximumHeight = worldClocks.height + agenda.height - agenda.Layout.minimumHeight;
+                }
+                onPositionChanged: mouse => {
+                    const newHeight = pressHeight - (mapToItem(leadingColumn, mouse.x, mouse.y).y - pressY);
+                    Plasmoid.configuration.timeZonesHeight = Math.round(Math.max(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 3, Math.min(newHeight, maximumHeight)));
+                }
+            }
         }
 
         // Clocks stuff
@@ -459,10 +482,13 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
             id: worldClocks
             visible: calendar.showClocks
 
+            readonly property bool customHeight: agenda.visible && Plasmoid.configuration.timeZonesHeight > 0
+
             Layout.fillWidth: true
             Layout.fillHeight: !agenda.visible
-            Layout.minimumHeight: visible ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 7 : 0
-            Layout.maximumHeight: agenda.visible ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10 : -1
+            Layout.minimumHeight: visible ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * (customHeight ? 3 : 7) : 0
+            Layout.preferredHeight: customHeight ? Plasmoid.configuration.timeZonesHeight : -1
+            Layout.maximumHeight: agenda.visible && !customHeight ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10 : -1
 
             ListView {
                 id: clocksList
diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/main.xml b/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
index 6716b906c5..309cfbe4ec 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
@@ -103,6 +103,10 @@
       <label>Whether the popup should remain open when another window is activated</label>
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="timeZonesHeight" type="Int">
+      <label>Height of the time zones list in the popup when events are also shown. 0 means automatic.</label>
+      <default>0</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="dateDisplayFormat" type="Enum">
       <label>Whether the date should be shown below or beside the time</label>
       <choices name="Settings::dateDisplayFormat">
--

media.caption: Master: dragging the line between Events and Time Zones up and down does nothing.
With the fix: dragging the line up gives the time zones list more room, stopping at the events list's minimum height.
Master: the split stays at its fixed position after the drags.
With the fix, after dragging the line down and restarting plasmashell: the larger events area is remembered.
Master: the same drag attempt, nothing moves.
With the fix: dragging the line down gives events more room; closing and reopening the popup keeps the size.
